summary: This diff is a pure, additive 206-line entry appended to ai-os/MASTER_INDEX.yaml's registries[] section, recording a timestamped live census of the 3 linked Vercel projects and 7 FChecklist GitHub repos; it touches no other file, no .github/workflows/**, no migrations/schema/auth/permission/billing/rls/security paths, and no .env files, so it fits tier1's additive/low-blast-radius definition cleanly. I validated the resulting YAML parses correctly and independently re-ran a sample of the census's own cited verification commands live via gh api against the real FChecklist repos: PR #84's merged/merged_at timestamp, PR #79/#80 dirty vs PR #82 clean mergeable_state, the org-vs-user 404, the private-repo branch-protection 403 message text, compliance-tracker's and veda-advisors's required_status_checks contexts, and global-revenue-engine's zero-commit/size=0 empty state all matched the census verbatim. The claude-control open_pr_count (7) also matched exactly once accounted for two new PRs (#85, #86) opened after the census's own 10:33:37Z timestamp and after this commit landed -- consistent with the concurrent-worker model described in SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md, not an error. No secret values were captured, only env var key names/presence, satisfying the task's own stated constraint. This is a well-scoped, self-verifying documentation update with no architecture, correctness, or security concerns, safe for autonomous tier1 merge.
issues: Minor/non-blocking: the census states global-revenue-engine's default_branch is 'NONE' because it has zero commits, but the GitHub REST API's default_branch field actually returns the configured value 'main' (only the GraphQL defaultBranchRef, which reflects actual refs, is empty) -- a trivial wording nuance on an empty, unused repo, not a factual error worth blocking on.
Diff does not touch .github/workflows/** -- the hard rule against direct workflow-file edits in worker tasks does not apply here.
